## About Me

I am a Postdoctoral researcher in ancient Biomolecules at the University of Turku 🇫🇮.
I conducted my PhD studies at the Institute of Genomics, University of Tartu 🇪🇪 and defended my dissertation titled The genetic history of the Mediterranean before the common era: a focus on the Italian Peninsula in August 2022. My research has mainly focused on the demographic history of the Mediterrean Basin during the Bronze Age period, however, I finally have decided to move on and will focus on Finnish population studies now.

In addition, in 2023, I co-founded the open and international Human Ancient DNA, Ancestry and Mobility (HAAM-) community for early career researchers studying human population history, ancestry & mobility through ancient DNA.

## Research Interests

* Human Population Genetics * Anthropology * Ancient Biomolecules * Languages
